#506 · Puppy Pokémon

Lillipup

Normal

Unova · Generation 5

Lillipup is a Normal-type Puppy Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 0.4 m tall and weighs 4.1 kg. It evolves into Herdier. Its highest base stat is Attack (60), with a base stat total of 275.
